inbox.title: Your tasks
inbox.intro: Once you submit every required document with a digital signature, the system passes them to the buyer's approvers.
inbox.empty: You have no tasks to do.
inbox.footer: You only see tasks for contracts that name your company. You cannot approve payments or change amounts.

file.empty: No file for this document yet

submit.dropzone: Add other documents (optional): drag and drop or choose files
submit.lockNote: Once signed, a document is locked. You can only submit a new version.

error.UNKNOWN: We could not submit the documents. Please try again.

aftermath.title: What happens after you submit
aftermath.validate: Document check. Documents only count if you are the contract's supplier and the signatures are valid.
aftermath.match: Match against the milestone. With all documents in, the milestone moves to approval. If something is missing, you are told straight away.
aftermath.approve: {{quorumWord}} approvers on the buyer side review the file and sign digitally before the payment is settled.
aftermath.result: You get the result: the amount paid, any penalty and the reason.

penalty.title: About the penalty
penalty.late_one: Delivery {{count}} day late at {{rate}}% per day on {{value}} million VND is {{penalty}} million VND. You will see this calculation in the result step, and you may open a dispute if you disagree.
penalty.late_other: Delivery {{count}} days late at {{rate}}% per day on {{value}} million VND is {{penalty}} million VND. You will see this calculation in the result step, and you may open a dispute if you disagree.
penalty.onTime: You are on time, so no penalty applies.

proposal.title: System proposal
proposal.explainLate_one: {{count}} day late × {{rate}}% per day × {{value}} = {{penalty}}. The {{cap}}% cap is {{capAmount}}, not reached.
proposal.explainLate_other: {{count}} days late × {{rate}}% per day × {{value}} = {{penalty}}. The {{cap}}% cap is {{capAmount}}, not reached.
proposal.explainCapped_one: {{count}} day late × {{rate}}% per day × {{value}} exceeds the cap. The {{cap}}% cap is {{capAmount}}, so the penalty is {{penalty}}.
proposal.explainCapped_other: {{count}} days late × {{rate}}% per day × {{value}} exceeds the cap. The {{cap}}% cap is {{capAmount}}, so the penalty is {{penalty}}.
proposal.explainOnTime: Delivered on time, so no penalty applies.
proposal.reason: Reason: {{reason}}. No dispute, documents complete and signatures valid.

consequences.title: What happens with each choice
consequences.approve: Approve and sign: once both roles have signed, the system fixes the penalty and sends the payment order for {{payable}} million.
consequences.hold: Hold (HOLD): the milestone stops, you record a reason, and it goes back to the contract owner.
consequences.reject: Reject (REJECT): a reason is required and this milestone is not paid.

note.label: Note or reason
note.required: Please give a reason when holding or rejecting.
